---
title: "What changed: edited papers"
---

Every pull request in a workspace gets a preview with a **What changed** page: each page it changes, with additions and removals marked, and the paper's PDF diff. Below is the one for a pull request with a fixed set of edits to this example's literature review and paper. Its page titles open the edited pages in a new tab.

::: {.column-body-outset-right}
<!-- template-demo-report -->
:::

```{=html}
<style>
#template-demo-report iframe { width: 100%; min-height: 80vh; border: 0; display: block; }
</style>
<script>
// Size the report to its content, and open its links to the edited pages in a
// new tab, so that the page reads as one page of this site.
(() => {
  const frame = document.querySelector('#template-demo-report iframe');
  if (!frame) return;
  frame.addEventListener('load', () => {
    const doc = frame.contentDocument;
    if (!doc) return;
    for (const link of doc.querySelectorAll('a[href]')) {
      if (!link.getAttribute('href').startsWith('#')) link.target = '_blank';
    }
    const fit = () => { frame.style.height = doc.documentElement.scrollHeight + 'px'; };
    fit();
    new ResizeObserver(fit).observe(doc.body);
  });
})();
</script>
```

Look for:

1. **A small literature review:** the revised Transformer claim, the added BERT claim, and the new reference.
2. **Paper:** the added citation and equation, the revised sentence, and the changed figure caption, in the HTML diff and the PDF diff.

The edits are `scripts/demo-edits.patch`, and each release builds the report from them. A local render shows no report above until `make demo-build` builds it.
